# Aerovant Technologies

> Aerovant Technologies is a cybersecurity and software company based in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu, India. We build ThreatReady, a platform to train, test and hire security engineers, and deliver cloud security (AWS), VAPT and managed security services to startups, SaaS companies and SMEs.

Based in Rayakkottai Road, Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu 635002, India. Contact: admin@aerovanttech.com, +91 90426 47714. We reply within one business day.

Key facts:
- What we build: ThreatReady (cybersecurity skills platform, https://threatready.io/).
- What we secure: AWS cloud environments, web applications, APIs and networks.
- Who we help: founders, CTOs and engineering heads at startups, SaaS companies and SMEs.
- Services: Cloud Security; Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing; Managed Security Services.

## Services
- [Cybersecurity services](https://aerovanttech.com/services/): Cloud security, VAPT and managed security services from Aerovant Technologies, for startups, SaaS companies and SMEs.
- [Cloud Security](https://aerovanttech.com/services/cloud-security/): AWS cloud security assessment and configuration review for startups and SMEs. Know what is exposed in your AWS environment and what to change first.
- [VAPT: Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing](https://aerovanttech.com/services/vapt/): Web application VAPT, API security testing and network penetration testing. Find out which weaknesses can actually be exploited, with evidence.
- [Managed Security Services](https://aerovanttech.com/services/managed-security/): Managed security services: SOC-as-a-Service, EDR, firewall and WAF management, and threat intelligence advisories from Aerovant Technologies.

## Product
- [ThreatReady](https://aerovanttech.com/products/): ThreatReady by Aerovant: train, test and hire security engineers on real work. Attack Reasoning Lab, Lab Simulations and InterviewPrep across 15 role tracks.
- [ThreatReady website](https://threatready.io/): Train, test and hire security engineers on real work, not on certificates.

- [eMudhra: The Certificate Scare That Ended in a Day, and the Deadline That Didn’t](https://aerovanttech.com/insights/emudhra-certificate-incident/): Chrome drops eMudhra’s emSign ECC Root CA - G3 on 27 October. Who is affected, why GST and MCA DSCs are safe, and a 10-minute check for your domains. (Cybersecurity, 2026-10-23)
- [php2shell: The PHP Bug That Fires Before Your Code Runs](https://aerovanttech.com/insights/php2shell/): php2shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Who is affected, a 10-minute exposure check, and how to patch. (Threat Intelligence, 2026-10-23)
